title: Package metadata
description: Centralized timing metadata for every package in the registry: when it was first published and when a new version was last added. Derived and maintained by the bot (generator/src/record-metadata.ts) from the registry's own git history; only repo admins may edit it directly.

firstPublished.description: When the package was first published to the registry.

lastUpdated.description: When a new version was last added to the package. Equal to firstPublished for a package that has never been updated.

backfilled.description: True when the dates were reconstructed from registry git history by the one-off migration (generator/src/backfill.ts) rather than recorded as packages were published.
